verdict.rationale: Stable has a documented public REST API. It authenticates with an x-api-key header, and keys are self-served in the dashboard. Reference pages cover the /v1/locations onboarding endpoints (Form 1583 session, signature packet) and company deactivation, and Checks are documented as an object. Webhooks and llms.txt are also available. However, the docs themselves say the API currently only supports searching and retrieving MailItems plus creating and onboarding Locations, so the core mail actions (scan, forward, shred, deposit, tag, route) have no documented API path. missing for 10: API coverage of mail actions (forward/shred/deposit/scan/tag/route), a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probed paths 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
